ruleDefinitions.name: NtdllPipe Like Activity Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects command that type the content of ntdll.dll to a different file or a pipe in order to evade AV / EDR detection. As seen being used in the POC NtdllPipe

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*type\\ \\%windir\\%\\\\system32\\\\ntdll\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*type\\ \\%systemroot\\%\\\\system32\\\\ntdll\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*type\\ c\\:\\\\windows\\\\system32\\\\ntdll\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ntdll\\\.dll\\ \\>\\ \\\\\\\\\\\.\\\\pipe\\\\.*"))
